snippet.title: Wild Island – Official Trailer | Roguelike Playtest Now Available
snippet.description:
A living island that reshapes itself every run. Craft absurd builds, unleash chaotic synergies, and restore your abandoned Sanctuary in Wild Island – a fast-paced top-down roguelike.

Playtest Wild Island on Steam NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214740/Wild_Island/

Join the Wild Island Community (feedback, bug reports, dev logs):
https://discord.gg/MJSb4jSNd9
---
WHAT IS WILD ISLAND?

Wild Island is a chaotic top-down roguelike where the island itself shifts every run. Swap between unique main weapons, stack powerful accessories, and create room-melting synergies that turn bullets, knives, and elements into pure chaos.

Between runs, return to your Sanctuary – fish, unlock new gear, and slowly rebuild a once-abandoned home.
---
EARLY PLAYTEST

This is an early playtest build – your feedback is incredibly valuable.  
If you try the game, please consider:

• Joining the Discord and telling me what felt fun / not fun  
• Reporting bugs and crashes  
• Sharing your craziest build or synergy

You’re helping shape what Wild Island becomes. ❤️
---
📌 Follow the development

Discord: https://discord.gg/MJSb4jSNd9

#WildIsland #indiegame #roguelike #roguelite #gamedev
